key.name: history-size
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned entries kept in clipboard history.

key.name: paste-on-select
key.description: After picking an entry, simulate a paste keypress (Shift+Insert) in the focused window. When off, the entry is only placed on the clipboard.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: When enabled, new clipboard contents are not recorded to history.

key.name: notify-on-copy
key.description: Show an OSD whenever new content is recorded to clipboard history.

key.name: confirm-clear
key.description: Require a second click on Clear history before entries are wiped.

key.name: strip-text
key.description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from copied text before storing it.

key.name: move-item-first
key.description: Move a selected entry to the top of the history.

key.name: cache-only-favorites
key.description: Only pinned entries are written to disk; unpinned history is lost on restart.

key.name: popup-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the clipboard popup at the pointer. Empty disables it.

key.name: next-entry
key.description: Cycle the clipboard to the next older history entry. Empty disables it.

key.name: prev-entry
key.description: Cycle the clipboard back to the previous newer history entry. Empty disables it.

key.name: clear-history
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that wipes unpinned history entries. Empty disables it.

key.name: enable-keybindings
key.description: Master switch for all extension keyboard shortcuts.

key.name: enable-typeahead-search
key.description: Show a search row at the top of the popup that filters history as you type.

key.name: process-primary-selection
key.description: Also record the PRIMARY selection (text selected with the mouse) into history.

key.name: ignore-password-mimes
key.description: Skip clipboard contents flagged by password managers.

key.name: toggle-private-mode
key.description: Keyboard shortcut toggling private mode. Empty disables it.

key.name: cache-size
key.description: Maximum total size of persisted clipboard history. Oldest unpinned entries are evicted when exceeded.

key.name: max-displayed-entries
key.description: Maximum number of history entries rendered in the popup; older entries stay in history but are not shown.

key.name: preview-length
key.description: Maximum characters shown per text entry in the popup.
